chat:
User: build me an app to track my expenses
AI: Sure! I'll set up a simple expense tracker with React and a small Express server. Here is the code...
User: it's not working
AI: Could you tell me what is happening? An error message or what you expected would help.
User: the page is blank. fix it
AI: A blank page often means a JavaScript error. Please open the browser console and share what it says.
User: idk how. just make it work and also add charts and login and dark mode
AI: That is a lot at once. Let's fix the blank page first, then add features one by one.
User: now it shows but when I add an expense and refresh it's gone
AI: The data lives in memory, so a refresh loses it. You need to store it somewhere permanent.
User: ok add a database

patterns: User asks for many features at once
User provides no goal or context
User does not share code or file locations
overview.strongest: The data lives in memory, so a refresh loses it. You need to store it somewhere permanent.
overview.weakest: build me an app to track my expenses

items.excerpt: build me an app to track my expenses
items.why: No stack, features, or goal are given, so the AI must guess everything and may build something unusable.
items.rewrite: Build an expense tracker using [React/Express/etc]. It should let users add, view, and delete expenses. Goal: [personal use / team tool / learning project].

items.why: There is no description of what is broken, what was expected, or where to look, making it impossible to help.
items.rewrite: I am trying to [do X] in [file name]. I expected [Y], but [Z] happened instead.

items.excerpt: the page is blank. fix it
items.why: A blank page has many causes; without the browser console error the AI cannot know which one to fix.
items.rewrite: The page is blank. I opened the browser console and saw: [paste the exact error here]. Please fix it.

items.excerpt: idk how. just make it work and also add charts and login and dark mode
items.why: Asking for a fix plus three large features at once overwhelms the model and produces low-quality, untested code.
items.rewrite: First fix the blank page. After that works, we will add charts, then login, then dark mode one at a time.

items.why: No database type, schema, or connection details are given, so the AI cannot know how to store the data safely.
items.rewrite: Add a [PostgreSQL/SQLite/MongoDB] database to persist expenses. Use this schema: [paste schema or describe fields].
